title.en: Handing out address blocks: CIDR allocation and aggregation
title.zh: 分配地址块：CIDR 的分配与聚合

description.en: How to give organisations blocks of addresses that are powers of 2 and start on a multiple of their size, and when several prefixes can be aggregated into one.
description.zh: 怎样给各机构分配大小为 2 的幂、并从自身大小的整数倍开始的地址块，以及几个前缀什么时候能聚合成一个。

name.zh: 无类别域间路由与路由聚合 (CIDR, aggregation)
IPv4 地址与前缀 (IPv4 addresses, prefixes)
最长前缀匹配 (longest matching prefix)

description.en: Starting a block right after the previous one even when that address is not a multiple of its size
description.zh: 紧接着上一块就开始分，即使那个地址不是本块大小的整数倍

title.en: A practice problem, in the style of the exam
title.zh: 练习题 · 仿考试题型

paras.en: A large number of consecutive IP addresses are available starting at 198.16.0.0. Suppose that four organisations, A, B, C and D, request 4000, 2000, 4000 and 8000 addresses respectively, and in that order.
paras.zh: 从 198.16.0.0 开始有大量连续的 IP 地址可用。假设 A、B、C、D 四个机构依次申请 4000、2000、4000 和 8000 个地址。

paras.en: For each of these, give the first IP address assigned, the last IP address assigned, and the mask in the w.x.y.z/s notation.
paras.zh: 对每个机构，给出分配的第一个 IP 地址、最后一个 IP 地址，以及 w.x.y.z/s 形式的掩码。

items.en: **Consecutive addresses starting at 198.16.0.0**: a free range to hand out from, lowest first.
items.zh: **从 198.16.0.0 开始的连续地址**：一段空闲的地址，从低往高分。

items.en: **In that order**: A is served first, then B, C and D, each from the lowest addresses still free.
items.zh: **依次**：先给 A，再给 B、C、D，每次都从还空着的最低地址开始。

items.en: **w.x.y.z/s**: a prefix, the block's first address and its number of network bits, as in the addressing lesson.
items.zh: **w.x.y.z/s**：一个前缀，即块的第一个地址加网络位数，和地址那一课一样。

title.zh: 一个地址块的两条规则

items.en: **Its size is a power of 2**: the smallest that holds the request. 4000 needs 4096 ($2^{12}$, a /20); 2000 needs 2048 ($2^{11}$, a /21); 8000 needs 8192 ($2^{13}$, a /19).

**It starts at a multiple of its size**. A prefix fixes the network bits and lets the host bits take every value, so the block's first address must have all its host bits 0. A /20 has 12 host bits, so its start is a multiple of 4096.
items.zh: **从自身大小的整数倍开始**。前缀固定网络位，让主机位取遍所有值，所以块的第一个地址的主机位必须全为 0。/20 有 12 位主机位，所以它的起点必须是 4096 的倍数。

text.en: Count in the **third byte**, since every block here is a whole number of 256-address steps: a /20 is 16 values of the third byte, a /21 is 8, a /19 is 32. A /20 must then start at a third byte that is a multiple of 16, a /21 at a multiple of 8, a /19 at a multiple of 32. Where the next free address is not such a multiple, the block skips ahead and leaves a gap, which can be handed out later.
text.zh: 按**第三个字节**来数，因为这里每个块都是 256 个地址的整数倍：/20 占第三个字节的 16 个值，/21 占 8 个，/19 占 32 个。于是 /20 必须从第三个字节为 16 的倍数处开始，/21 从 8 的倍数，/19 从 32 的倍数。下一个空闲地址不是这样的倍数时，就跳到下一个倍数，中间留出空档，以后还能再分。

alt.en: A line of third-byte values from 0 to 96 for 198.16.x.0: A, a /20, from 0 to 16; B, a /21, from 16 to 24; free from 24 to 32; C, a /20, from 32 to 48; free from 48 to 64; D, a /19, from 64 to 96.

caption.en: The four blocks, by their third byte. C cannot start at 24 and D cannot start at 48: neither is a multiple of the block's size.
caption.zh: 四个块，按第三个字节画出。C 不能从 24 开始，D 不能从 48 开始：都不是本块大小的整数倍。

say.en: A starts at the beginning: third byte 0 is a multiple of 16. It covers 16 values of the third byte, 0 to 15.
say.zh: A 从头开始：第三个字节 0 是 16 的倍数。它占第三个字节的 16 个值，0 到 15。

say.en: The next free third byte is 16, a multiple of 8: B fits there, 16 to 23.
say.zh: 下一个空闲的第三个字节是 16，是 8 的倍数：B 正好放这儿，16 到 23。

say.en: The next free is 24, not a multiple of 16; C skips to 32 and covers 32 to 47.
say.zh: 下一个空闲的是 24，不是 16 的倍数；C 跳到 32，占 32 到 47。

say.en: The next free is 48, not a multiple of 32; D skips to 64 and covers 64 to 95.
say.zh: 下一个空闲的是 48，不是 32 的倍数；D 跳到 64，占 64 到 95。

prompt.en: C needs a /20, whose third byte must start at a multiple of 16, and the next free third byte is 24. Where does C start?
prompt.zh: C 要一个 /20，第三个字节必须从 16 的倍数开始，而下一个空闲的第三个字节是 24。C 从哪儿开始？

paras.en: Each block is the smallest power of 2 that holds the request, and must start at a multiple of its size: A 4096 (/20), B 2048 (/21), C 4096 (/20), D 8192 (/19).
paras.zh: 每个块取装得下申请数的最小的 2 的幂，并且必须从自身大小的整数倍开始：A 4096（/20），B 2048（/21），C 4096（/20），D 8192（/19）。

text.en: Mention the gaps if there is room: 198.16.24.0 to 198.16.31.255 and 198.16.48.0 to 198.16.63.255 stay free for later requests. The usual slip is to start C at 198.16.24.0, which is not a /20.

title.en: A practice problem, in the style of the exam
title.zh: 练习题 · 仿考试题型

paras.en: A router has just received the following new IP addresses: 57.6.96.0/21, 57.6.104.0/21, 57.6.112.0/21 and 57.6.120.0/21. If all of them use the same outgoing line, can they be aggregated? If so, to what? If not, why not?
paras.zh: 一台路由器刚收到以下新的 IP 地址：57.6.96.0/21、57.6.104.0/21、57.6.112.0/21 和 57.6.120.0/21。如果它们都走同一条出口线路，能不能聚合？能的话，聚合成什么？不能的话，为什么？

items.en: **Aggregated**: replaced in the routing table by one larger prefix that covers exactly these blocks, so one row does the work of four.
items.zh: **聚合**：在路由表里用一个更大的、正好覆盖这些块的前缀来代替，一行顶四行。

items.en: **The same outgoing line**: the condition that makes it safe; addresses with different lines cannot share a row.
items.zh: **同一条出口线路**：这是聚合安全的前提；出口不同的地址不能共用一行。

say.en: The four third bytes in binary. A /21 fixes 16 + 5 bits: the first 5 bits of the third byte.
say.zh: 四个第三字节写成二进制。/21 固定 16 + 5 位：第三个字节的前 5 位。

say.en: Their first 5 bits: they share 011 and take all four values of the next two bits.
say.zh: 它们的前 5 位：共同的是 011，后两位取遍了全部四种值。

say.en: So together they are exactly the block whose first 19 bits are 57.6 and 011.
say.zh: 所以合起来，正好是前 19 位为 57.6 和 011 的那个块。

say.en: One prefix covering third bytes 96 to 127: $4 \times 2048 = 8192$ addresses, no more and no fewer.
say.zh: 一个前缀覆盖第三个字节 96 到 127：$4 \times 2048 = 8192$ 个地址，不多也不少。

prompt.en: The four blocks share the first 16 bits and 3 more. What is the length of the aggregated prefix?
prompt.zh: 四个块共享前 16 位，再加 3 位。聚合后的前缀长度是多少？

text.en: The answer is yes or no with the reason in binary: which bits the blocks share, and that together they fill the larger block.
text.zh: 答案是能或不能，并用二进制说明理由：这些块共享哪几位，以及它们合起来是否正好填满更大的块。

paras.en: Yes. In binary, the third bytes are 01100000, 01101000, 01110000 and 01111000. The four /21 blocks share their first 19 bits (57.6 and 011) and together cover every value of the remaining bits, so they form exactly one block: 57.6.96.0/19 (third byte 96 to 127). With the same outgoing line, the four entries can be replaced by this single one.
paras.zh: 能。第三个字节的二进制分别是 01100000、01101000、01110000 和 01111000。这四个 /21 块共享前 19 位（57.6 和 011），合起来又取遍了其余位的所有值，所以正好构成一个块：57.6.96.0/19（第三个字节 96 到 127）。既然出口相同，这四条表项就可以换成这一条。

text.en: Aggregation needs three things: the same outgoing line; blocks that together fill a whole larger block, with nothing missing; and that larger block correctly aligned. Without 57.6.120.0/21, the other three cannot become one /19: it would also cover 120 to 127, which goes elsewhere.
text.zh: 聚合要满足三条：出口相同；几个块合起来正好填满一个更大的块，一点不缺；这个大块的起点要对齐。少了 57.6.120.0/21，剩下三个就不能合成一个 /19：那会把 120 到 127 也包进来，而它们走的是别的路。

text.en: Even then a router can save rows, thanks to longest prefix match: one row for 57.6.96.0/19 on the common line, and one for the exception 57.6.120.0/21 on its own line. The longer prefix wins for addresses in the exception, as in the addressing lesson's London and San Francisco example.
text.zh: 即使这样，路由器靠最长前缀匹配也能省行：一行 57.6.96.0/19 指向共同的出口，再一行 57.6.120.0/21 指向它自己的出口，作为例外。落在例外里的地址，更长的前缀胜出，就像地址那一课伦敦和旧金山的例子。

prompt.en: An organisation needs 900 addresses, and the lowest free address is 10.0.6.0. What block does it get?
prompt.zh: 一个机构需要 900 个地址，最低的空闲地址是 10.0.6.0。它分到哪个块？

feedback.en: A /22 spans 4 values of the third byte and must start at a multiple of 4; 6 is not one.
feedback.zh: /22 占第三个字节的 4 个值，必须从 4 的倍数开始；6 不是。

explain.en: 900 needs 1024 addresses, a /22, which starts at a third byte that is a multiple of 4: the first one free is 8.
explain.zh: 900 需要 1024 个地址，即 /22，它的第三个字节要从 4 的倍数开始：空着的第一个是 8。

prompt.en: Can 57.6.96.0/21 and 57.6.112.0/21 alone be aggregated into one prefix?

label.en: No: the smallest block covering both, 57.6.96.0/19, also contains 104 and 120
label.zh: 不能：同时覆盖两者的最小的块 57.6.96.0/19 还包含 104 和 120

feedback.en: 57.6.96.0/20 covers third bytes 96 to 111: it includes 104 but not 112.

explain.en: Two blocks merge into one only if they are the two halves of a larger block. 96 and 112 are not adjacent.
explain.zh: 两个块只有恰好是某个更大块的两半时，才能合成一个。96 和 112 并不相邻。
